Feature: Event Log Storage and Content
  As a user
  I want the system to store an event log in non-volatile memory
  So that I can review the system's history

  Scenario: Event Log is Stored in Non-Volatile Memory
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the user confirms ventilation settings
    Then the event log is stored in non-volatile memory

  Scenario: Event Log Includes Confirmed Ventilation Settings
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the user confirms ventilation settings
    Then the event log includes all confirmed ventilation settings

  Scenario: Event Log Includes Date and Timestamp
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the user confirms ventilation settings
    Then the event log includes a date and timestamp

  Scenario: Event Log Includes Changes to Real Time Clock
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the user changes the real time clock
    Then the event log includes the current date/time followed by the new date/time

  Scenario Outline: Event Log Content with Examples
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the user confirms ventilation settings with <settings>
    Then the event log includes all confirmed ventilation settings with <settings>

    Examples:
      | settings        |
      | Normal          |
      | High            |
      | Low             |
      | Invalid Setting |

  Scenario Outline: Event Log Content with Examples (Real Time Clock)
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the user changes the real time clock to <new_date_time>
    Then the event log includes the current date/time followed by <new_date_time>

    Examples:
      | new_date_time          |
      | 2022-01-01 12:00:00    |
      | 2022-01-01 23:59:59    |
      | 2022-01-02 00:00:00    |
      | Invalid Date/Time      |
